name: Absalom
overview: Absalom, also known as Abishalom, was the son of King David and Maacah, noted for his remarkable beauty and complex family dynamics. Scripture reveals his deep hatred for his brother Amnon, who had wronged their sister Tamar, leading Absalom to orchestrate a calculated plan involving a sheep-shearing feast to exact justice. Despite the tension, David's interactions with Absalom show a reluctant but loving father-son relationship, as he cautiously permits Absalom and his servants to attend the event, highlighting the tragic unfolding of familial conflict.
